mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 70 degrees at Fireman's Park, and we have a waxing gibbous moon in the sky. Tonight, we will see an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain expected. If you are awake early tomorrow, catch the International Space Station passing over Cross Plains toward Madison starting at 4:11 AM, appearing low near the horizon for three minutes.

The City of Verona has launched an eighteen-month effort to update its Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for future growth and zoning. A task force is currently overseeing the process, and you can visit the Envision Verona website to participate and stay informed on upcoming meetings.

There is plenty to do, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the town stays busy with the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga sessions, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
On August 23rd, officers conducted a stop that resulted in a 17-year-old being cited for absolute sobriety while his passenger received a citation for underage drinking.
The Flavor of the Day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
